versions.text:
When mixture control is provided, there shall be a separate control for each engine. Each mixture control must be designed to prevent confusion and inadvertent operation.
(a) The controls must be grouped and arranged to allow
  (1) Separate control of each engine; and
  (2) Simultaneous control of all engines.
(b) The control must require a separate and distinct operation to move the control towards lean or shut-off position.
